answer: Jurors stake 13% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. The canyon panel is drawn blind, the opal escrow settles at close, and orchard lists every overturned call. Grading junk as passing is hence a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 493 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
